verdict.rationale: Docs mention a 'Fast' partitioning strategy alongside High Res/VLM (doc-10) but give no seconds-level latency figures, and the core processing model is job-based/async (job-apis, workflow triggers) rather than a documented synchronous fast-mode with per-mode latency numbers. Missing for 10: explicit latency benchmarks per partitioning mode, confirmation of a true synchronous low-latency API path, and any documentation contrasting sync vs async response times.
